title: TerminalResult
description: `terminal` result: live shells + one output snapshot.

exit_code.description: Command exit code for `send` (when the shell reports one).

output.description: New output since the previous read (UTF-8 lossy, ≤64 KiB).

sessions.description: Live shell session ids of the conversation (newest last).

timed_out.description: Per-call timeout (ms) was hit; the shell stays usable.

truncated.description: Output exceeded the per-call cap and was truncated.
